AKRES — a real-estate CRM app (2026).

A broker's day is split across WhatsApp, a notebook, three spreadsheets and memory. AKRES puts it on one screen: who to call today, which buyer fits which listing, which site visit is tomorrow, what is still unpaid.

Designed, written and built single-handed — product, interface and code — and live on the App Store.

Product design & engineering — Anirudh Kapoor. A·79.
